name: FAQ disclosure
summary: Questions in native <details> elements with a plus that turns into a cross when open.
accessibility: Each question is a native <summary>, so Enter and Space toggle it and screen readers announce expanded or collapsed.
The plus sign is aria-hidden; its rotation only runs when the user hasn't asked for reduced motion.
Questions open independently. Opening one doesn't close another.

states.name: open
states.description: The answer shows under the question and the plus rotates 45 degrees.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A 2px outline in the focus color around the question row.
